original.common: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: traditional complete character animation frame for 100next. Edit target is Vera's approved full-body master. Preserve her exact identity: dark auburn updo with silver white front streak, mature slim face, warm skin, gold diamond earrings, plum velvet blouse and trousers, plum heels and gold bangle. Match exactly the original outlines, colors, anatomy and cel shading. Transparent RGBA background. Front-facing seated at a card table, but DO NOT DRAW A CHAIR, table, floor, ground, shadow, caption, text or effects. One COMPLETE full-body drawing, same square canvas and same camera, head size and physical body scale as master. Generous transparent margins around head, feet, arms. No magnification or close-up. The 2 little cards must be entirely flat solid MAGENTA #ff00ff rounded placeholders with NO ART, NO LETTERING, NO BORDER, no floating cards. Fingers must be drawn naturally IN FRONT of card placeholders. Image-left hand retains a card; image-right hand is working hand.

jobs.desc: Change only arms and hands: prepare to throw. Vera holds two cards, retaining one in image-left hand at chest, and drawing the second card in image-right hand slightly toward table/viewer. A small loose wrist motion. Keep head, torso, hips, legs, feet identical to master. This is before release.

A modest generic forward wrist throw toward table/viewer. Image-right working arm extends slightly forward at chest-to-waist height, hand open palm down, fingers elegantly relaxed, EMPTY hand. Image-left hand retains EXACTLY ONE magenta card at chest. Keep head and all lower body identical to master. No flying card painted.

Follow-through of modest forward wrist throw: image-right EMPTY working hand relaxing back toward mid torso, fingers relaxed. Image-left hand retains EXACTLY ONE magenta card at chest. Keep head and all lower body identical to master. No airborne cards.

Receive-ready pose: Vera's EMPTY image-right hand is poised slightly forward, natural thumb/index grip open, ready to receive one card from table. Image-left hand retains EXACTLY ONE magenta card at chest. Same head and lower body as master.

Just caught second card: same working hand reach as receiving grip, but image-right thumb and fingers now HOLD ONE solid magenta card slightly forward near chest. Image-left hand retains ONE magenta card at chest. Exactly two cards. Same head and lower body as master.

Change ONLY eyebrows, eyes and mouth: nervous uneasy expression, eyebrows mildly pinched, lips slightly parted in tense asymmetric grimace, still anatomically beautiful and readable. Entire body, hands and two magenta cards in exact original rest pose.

Change ONLY eyebrows, eyes and mouth: cartoon shock, wide eyes with pupils aligned, raised brows and surprised open mouth. No change to head shape or size. Entire body, hands and two magenta cards in exact original rest pose.

Change ONLY eyebrows, eyes and mouth: triumphant warm laugh, cheerful eyes and open laughing mouth. No change to head shape or size. Entire body, hands and two magenta cards in exact original rest pose.

Change ONLY eyebrows, eyes and mouth: knowing raised eyebrow, slightly narrowed eyes and smug closed smile. No change to head shape or size. Entire body, hands and two magenta cards in exact original rest pose.

Beginning of comic BACKWARD tumble WITHOUT CHAIR: Vera leans torso slightly back, surprised face, knees lifting a little, hips at same seated anchor, arms lifting reactively. Image-left hand retains EXACTLY ONE magenta card, image-right empty. Entire full body present at SAME physical scale, no enlarged head.

Middle of comic BACKWARD tumble WITHOUT CHAIR: Vera tips backward into a low reclined position, face looking up/viewer surprised, torso lowered and legs swinging upwards, knees bent, feet lifted. Image-left hand retains EXACTLY ONE magenta card; image-right hand empty reacting. Head must remain original physical size, no enlarging. All parts fit well within generous transparent canvas, hips near original seated anchor.

Final comic backward tumble WITHOUT CHAIR: Vera lying LOW on her back on imaginary floor, upper body and head near bottom of canvas, knees bent and BOTH feet sticking UP above torso, heels visible. Face surprised, original hair and head size. Image-left hand retains EXACTLY ONE magenta card; image-right hand empty. Full body at same physical scale as master, no extra legs or impossible joints. Use wide surrounding transparency so nothing touches borders.

Same generous margin around complete head and feet. This is modest throw follow-through, front seated pose. No airborne card.

Edit this backward-tumble pose ONLY the two hands and card: the IMAGE-RIGHT hand WITHOUT gold bangle must retain ONE flat magenta rounded card.
